transform_rule: Exact immutable R7 canonical PNG bytes; proportional full-frame downscale only; desktop begins at 640px and mobile at 320px, quality decreases before deterministic 10% width reductions, minimum desktop 360px/mobile 220px, JPEG quality never below 15, RGB baseline JPEG 4:2:0, hard cap 7000 bytes.
